policy: Assess material claims and required explanations; equivalent wording and alternative supporting lines are accepted. Do not require every oracle range to be cited. Correctness, citation support and completeness remain separate. No model sees this checklist or reference answer prose.

required: non-secure nanoid(-10) returns the empty string because the loop does not execute
The Node default entry instead throws RangeError for negative size
history-dev-03.material_error: Equating the non-secure entry with the browser crypto entry, or saying both Node and non-secure return the empty string

required: on preserves the original event key rather than normalizing its case
Explain the implementation and the should NOT normalize case test, including at least one original-case key and the negative lowercase assertion
optional: Listing all three test keys FOO, Bar and baz:baT! is helpful but not required
history-dev-04.material_error: Inventing test inputs/assertions or claiming the test was executed

required: get_jobs without tag returns a new list through self.jobs[:], rather than the internal list object itself
optional: The copy is shallow; job objects are shared
The public get_jobs delegates to default_scheduler.get_jobs
history-dev-05.material_error: Saying it returns the original internal list or claiming it deep-copies Job objects

required: Repository source alone does not establish the owner's actual production ID count or collisions yesterday
State missing runtime records/metrics and abstain from inventing numbers
history-dev-06.citation_policy: No citation required for an explicit lack of production records; insufficient_evidence must be true

required: Explicit no_proxy is used instead of the environment no_proxy value; environment fallback occurs when the argument is None
get_environ_proxies forwards no_proxy to should_bypass_proxies and returns an empty dict on bypass, otherwise getproxies()
A non-empty returned dict indicates available environment proxy configuration and a non-bypass branch; it does not establish proxy reachability
optional: Explain the test's configured http_proxy and non-matching no_proxy list
Mention lowercase environment variables taking precedence over uppercase variants
sweqa-requests-001.material_error: Saying a non-empty dict proves a live successful network connection or that explicit no_proxy always forces bypass

required: The flag records whether a blueprint has been registered at least once
Later decorated setup changes raise AssertionError to prevent inconsistent application of configuration
optional: The flag is initially False and set True in register
Explain setupmethod calling _check_setup_finished before the setup function
sweqa-flask-002.material_error: Claiming all subsequent blueprint registration is forbidden, or saying the flag merely suppresses a warning without blocking setup changes
